title: Hours and minutes
prompt: Given a number of minutes, return an array with two numbers: [hours, leftover minutes]. For example 90 minutes is [1, 30].
hint: `total_minutes / 60` on two ints gives the whole hours (90 / 60 is 1). `total_minutes % 60` gives the minutes left over.
solution:
func solve(total_minutes: int) -> Array:
	var hours = total_minutes / 60
	var minutes = total_minutes % 60
	return [hours, minutes]
